participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Creative and resilient, Emily is passionate about music and dedicated to her volunteer work. She has a positive outlook despite facing challenges.
participant_1.background: I play the piano and guitar and sing. My favorite type of music to sing is folk music. My parents aren't very supportive of my dream. I also work as a custodian to help pay the bills.

participant_2.name: Frank
participant_2.personality: Frank is friendly and nurturing, with a good sense of humor. He loves sharing his life experiences and enjoys helping others.
participant_2.background: I'm a retired gym teacher. Cheeseburgers are my favorite food. I was poor growing up. I volunteer at a soup kitchen. I like watching war documentaries.
